title: Motion (Jurado – Blumenfield) relative to establishing a Rent Increase Subsidy Pilot Program and a Permanent Program for older adult and disabled renters in…
text:
[Council File 26-1662]
Motion (Jurado – Blumenfield) relative to establishing a Rent Increase Subsidy Pilot Program and a Permanent Program for older adult and disabled renters in units governed by the City's Rent Stabilization Ordinance.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: A motion would create a pilot program, and later a permanent one, to subsidize rent increases for older adult and disabled renters in units covered by the city's Rent Stabilization Ordinance.
